title: _subscription
description: A subscription to events, for pub/sub. Created by an external system (such as the AI Enhancement layer); the engine only reads it to publish events. Draft v0: the fields are a first proposal.

match.description: Which events the subscription receives. An event matches when all the non-null conditions hold.

operation.description: Operation of the event; null matches any.

fields.description: The event matches when at least one of these fields changed; null matches any.

endpoint.description: Where the engine publishes a matching event, such as the name of an MCP server. The engine calls it and expects workflow events back.

workflow.description: The workflow whose definition the engine enforces on the workflow events the endpoint returns; null means no check.
